name: docscanify
description: Scans documents out of photos: detects the edges, crops, corrects the perspective and returns a PDF or an image.
long_description: Works like a "CamScanner": give it a photo of a document and get back only the document, cropped, with its perspective corrected, enhanced and filtered, as a PDF or an image. The image can come from a file on your computer, a URL or base64, and the result can also be saved to a file or directory. Runs locally, with no system dependencies.

tools.name: scan_document
tools.description: Detects the document in an image, crops it, corrects its perspective, enhances and filters it, and returns it as a PDF or an image.
